fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Your customers trust you. You can trust us.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: How Fieldnote protects interview recordings, transcripts and the people in them.

default.question: Where do you store our recordings?
default.answer: In the region you pick when you sign up: Canada, the EU or the US. Everything is encrypted at rest and in transit.

default.question: Is Fieldnote SOC 2 compliant?
default.answer: Yes. We pass a SOC 2 Type II audit every year and share the report under NDA as part of our security pack.

default.question: Who can see our interviews?
default.answer: Only people in your workspace. You decide who can watch full recordings and who only sees approved highlights.

default.question: Can we delete a recording for good?
default.answer: Yes. Deleting removes the video, audio and transcript right away, and our backups forget it within 30 days.

default.question: Do participants know they are being recorded?
default.answer: Always. Fieldnote announces itself when it joins a call, and you can attach a consent form to every invite.
